title: Phosphorous waterborne polyurethanes/single-walled carbon nanotube composites as flame retardant building materials and their application in architectural design
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29646-29653
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05374A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Junyu Pan, Yang Zhong
Novel P/SWCNTs/WPUs were fabricated by an in situ polymerization, in which SWCNTs were prepared via a floating CVD. P/SWCNTs/WPUs could be used as flame retardant building materials in architectural design.
